footnote_text: The transaction reported on this Form 4 was effected pursuant to a Rule 10b5-1 trading plan adopted by the Reporting Person on March 14, 2025. The Reporting Person adopted the plan at a time when they were not aware of any material nonpublic information about the Company. || Includes 3,361 restricted stock units previously granted, each of which represents a contingent right to receive one share of the Issuer's common stock upon vesting.
